priority: AAA visual-quality target and full workbench functionality take precedence over source size. The user explicitly permits several megabytes. Do not sacrifice lighting or features to retain an old 20 KB limit.
runtimeStorage: Seeded scalar density, noise and optical-depth data generated in browser memory. No stored cloud photographs, image atlases, HDR photos, imported cloud meshes or image-generation assets.
windConvention: Wind direction is meteorological wind-from bearing. +X is east and -Z is north. 270 degrees transports toward +X; 0 degrees transports toward +Z. Wind and cloud drift are independent unless the linkage checkbox is enabled.
lighting: Linear HDR where supported; directional optical-depth cache; two near-light density samples; multiple-scattering approximation; separate sunlight, sky, silver-lining and ground contributions; continuous dawn/noon/dusk/night; one final tone-mapping pass.
sampling: Conservative expanded cloud-group intervals, exact clipped segment lengths, zero optical integration across empty gaps, world-space temporal reprojection with depth/transmittance rejection and neighborhood clamping. Midpoint sampling during invalid history and explicit temporal-off mode.
visualChanges: cooler internal folds and brighter illuminated edges
connected asymmetric storm fan and overshooting dome
boundaryRule: Reject a generated volume whose source support reaches the checked boundary. Retain empty density borders and conservative deformation margins. Never cut the data merely to pass a boundary check.
assistantInspection: Cu and Cb candidates were inspected via actual rendered browser frames in memory. This is not user visual approval or an AAA certification.
terrainInteraction: Analytical graphical updraft near demonstration hills; no real DEM modified.
aircraftInteraction: Procedural schematic aircraft and local graphical wake deformation; full aerodynamics not implemented.
precipitation: Graphical screen-space rain/snow, not hydrometeor simulation.
rainbow: Primary/secondary antisolar angular approximation, not a full spectral droplet solver.
retiredCandidate: Do not show rejected Cloud Mother V0.3.2 as new work. Weather Mother is the continuing production line. V060 remains available as the previous baseline.
